```yaml
name: Test Meshery Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify test script exists
        run: |
          if ! grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json > /dev/null; then
            echo "❌ No test script found in package.json"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Pack Sistent
        id: pack
        run: |
          tarball=$(npm pack)
          echo "TARBALL=$tarball" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Checkout Meshery UI
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: meshery/meshery
          path: meshery
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Sistent tarball into Meshery
        working-directory: meshery
        run: npm install $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$TARBALL

      - name: Install Meshery dependencies
        working-directory: meshery
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Meshery
        working-directory: meshery
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run Meshery tests
        working-directory: meshery
        run: npm test
        continue-on-error: true
        id: meshery-test

      - name: Post failure comment
        if: steps.meshery-test.outcome != 'success'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const message = `❌ Meshery integration tests failed for this PR. Please check the logs.`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: message
            });

      - name: Fail job if tests failed
        if: steps.meshery-test.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

      - name: Post success comment
        if: steps.meshery-test.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const message = `✅ Meshery integration tests passed for this PR.`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: message
            });
```
